items.description: Memcached install and service tasks: install package, create system user/group (memcache), create /var/log/memcached and /var/run/memcached dirs, start+enable memcached service
items.notes: Not fixable without source Chef template: memcached role variables (cache_memcached_memory, cache_memcached_port, cache_memcached_maxconn, etc.) are defined in defaults/main.yml but never applied to the running service. The memcached package on Debian/Ubuntu uses /etc/memcached.conf; on RHEL it uses /etc/sysconfig/memcached. A configuration template would be needed to apply these variables. This is a functional gap but out of scope for this review pass — flagged for follow-up.

items.description: Memcached package install sub-recipe: install memcached package, create system group and user (shell=/bin/false, home=/nonexistent)
items.notes: Merged _package.rb (package install, user/group, directories) into memcached.yml.

items.description: Redis install tasks: install build prerequisites (tar, gcc, make), download redis-3.2.11.tar.gz, compile from source (make clean && make && make install), place binaries in /usr/local/bin
items.notes: Duplicate PAM su task removed. The make install shell task uses args: creates: which is the correct placement for ansible.builtin.shell — no change needed there.

items.description: Redis build prerequisites: install tar package (Debian and RHEL)
items.notes: Merged into redis_install.yml.

items.description: Redis configure tasks: create redis user/group, create /etc/redis, /var/lib/redis, /var/run/redis/6379, /var/log/redis dirs, render redis.conf.j2 → /etc/redis/6379.conf (breadcrumb guard), create breadcrumb, render redis@.service.j2 → /lib/systemd/system/redis@6379.service, create /etc/tmpfiles.d/redis@6379.conf, post-process config to strip deprecated directives, set ulimit
items.notes: Fixed: vars: block for 'Deploy Redis systemd unit file' was indented under notify: (making it a child of the notify list), so Ansible could not see it as a task-level key. Moved vars: to correct task-level indentation. Also cleaned up misplaced comment block that was inside the notify: block.

items.notes: Merged into redis_configure.yml (start/enable service).

items.description: Disable OS-default Redis service (redis-server on Debian, redis on RHEL) to prevent conflict with source-compiled instance
items.notes: Merged into redis_install.yml.

items.description: PAM ulimit configuration for Redis: deploy /etc/pam.d/su template and /etc/pam.d/sudo file (Debian/Ubuntu only)
items.notes: Fixed: Duplicate 'Configure PAM su for ulimit support' task removed from redis_install.yml. The task correctly lives only in redis_configure.yml (ulimit config belongs in configure phase, not install phase).

items.description: redisio::default orchestration recipe — apt update, install build-essential, call install/disable_os_default/configure sub-recipes
items.notes: Merged into redis_install.yml (apt_update, build_essential, include_recipe calls).

items.description: Redis configuration file template → /etc/redis/6379.conf; must omit replica-serve-stale-data, replica-read-only, repl-ping-replica-period, client-output-buffer-limit, replica-priority (deprecated in Redis 3.2.11); requirepass sourced from vault variable
items.notes: Converted ERB to Jinja2. Deprecated directives (replica-serve-stale-data, replica-read-only, repl-ping-replica-period, client-output-buffer-limit, replica-priority) are omitted directly in the template instead of post-processing hack.

items.description: Systemd unit template for Redis → /lib/systemd/system/redis@6379.service; ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redis-server /etc/redis/6379.conf --daemonize no; LimitNOFILE=10032; User=redis; Group=redis
items.notes: Converted ERB to Jinja2 systemd unit template.

items.description: PAM su template → /etc/pam.d/su (Debian/Ubuntu only, controls PAM su limits for Redis ulimit)
items.notes: Static PAM su config - no ERB variables, copied as-is to Jinja2 template.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /etc/redis/6379.conf, /etc/redis/6379.conf.breadcrumb, /lib/systemd/system/redis@6379.service, /etc/tmpfiles.d/redis@6379.conf, /usr/local/bin/redis-server, /usr/local/bin/redis-cli, /var/lib/redis, /var/run/redis/6379, /var/log/redis, /var/log/memcached, /var/run/memcached; verifies redis@6379 and memcached services active+enabled; checks ports 6379 and 11211; verifies deprecated directives absent from redis.conf; verifies requirepass present
items.notes: Two-play verify: Play 1 checks Redis binaries, config files, deprecated-directive removal, systemd unit content, service state, port 6379. Play 2 checks Memcached directories, ownership, service state, port 11211, user existence, and OS-default Redis service is stopped.
